en.summary: This entry from al-Ghadā'irī’s *Kitāb al-Du‘afā* highlights Muḥammad ibn Sālim al-Kindī al-Sijistānī, a narrator known for transmitting from his father, with a specific note on the weakness (*da‘f*) in his *ḥadīth*. This assessment reflects the rigorous scrutiny applied by Shia scholars to the chain of transmission (*isnād*), ensuring the authenticity of religious teachings by identifying narrators whose reliability may be compromised by memory lapses or other defects.
